overview: The storefront uses an nginx proxy, a shop API, internal DNS and a PostgreSQL database. Service names and addresses connect these layers.

services.name: nginx
services.role: Receives storefront requests and forwards them to the shop application.

services.name: shop
services.role: Handles storefront pages, checkout requests and order data.

services.name: coredns
services.role: Resolves internal service names used by the application stack.

services.name: postgres
services.role: Stores orders for the shop application.
